name: Nachos (double-decker)
title: Nachos

steps.text: Finely chop the onion, quarter the cherry tomatoes, grate the cheddar, chop the spring onions.
1 tbsp oil in a frying pan, medium heat. Onion in for 3 to 5 minutes until soft.
Heat up. Beef mince in with the paprika, cumin and chilli powder. Cook 5 to 10 minutes until browned.
Heat down to medium. Black beans in until hot. Season with salt and pepper.
Layer in the dish: tortilla chips, half the beef, half the cheese, half the tomatoes. Then chips, the rest of the beef and the rest of the cheese.
Into the oven for 8 to 10 minutes until the cheese has melted.
Top with the remaining tomatoes, spring onions, coriander and chilli. Serve with soured cream, guacamole and lime wedges.

serves: 2 as a main, 4 as a starter
